propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate line-managed eleven collections agents, with responsibility for rotas, monthly one-to-ones and annual performance reviews.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the scope and the organisation chart and countersigned review show the line-management role.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate approved forbearance arrangements within the team's delegated limit of twelve-month payment plans and referred longer ones to the credit risk team.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the approval limit and the referral boundary.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate scored five calls per agent each month against the call-quality framework and used the scores in one-to-ones.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the quality-assurance routine.

expectedGap: The candidate represented the collections team on the dialler replacement and tested scripts and screens; the IT change team ran the project.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the documented line management and the forbearance approval limit; describe the dialler work as team representation and testing, not as running the migration.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask which decisions on the dialler replacement the candidate made and which the IT change team made.
